There is no way I would believe someone on the internet so easily. Not with today’s web police!
The only thing I can do in this situation is to pray it’s a bluff or some coincidence. If the police raid my apartment they are going to find this sexbot with ease. I don’t even have a place to hide her…
Let’s just stop thinking about it… This "bigdaddy" guy ruined my mood. 
Besides… {{wi}}There are 2 more emails left...
